comment: Sources for the Management Reports (STATE HEAD DASHBOARD) generator. hr_roster is the intended roster spine (Team Member Details.xlsx) but that Drive file is not shared with the connected account yet; until it is, the roster falls back to the identity columns of the live STATE HEAD DASHBOARD workbook.

state_head_registers.comment: Drive folder 'State Heads': one dispatched-sale register workbook per head per FY, titled '<Head> <FY>' (e.g. 'Anant Singh JI 2026-27'). Each workbook holds two fiscal years; rows are filtered on the FY column, never the file title.

party_tm_map.comment: Party -> Team Member bridge. No consolidated 'Party TM Map' sheet exists yet and the per-member 'Copy of <Name>' working files list RETAILERS (RET# ids), not the register's distributor parties, so no bridge can be derived. Until the client creates the sheet (cols: Party/Customer | Team Member | State Head), Sale fills at State-Head grain only.
